{{Quote|It seems they're receiving new arms shipments directly from a supply ship orbiting&hellip;|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], informing Jedi General [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] of the Umbarans' Separatist supply ship|<ref name="Plan of Dissent">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>}}
The '''Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel''', otherwise identified as the '''DH-Omni Support Vessel''' or '''DH-O Support Vessel''', and dubbed as the '''Separatist supply ship''', '''Separatist support ship''' or the '''Separatist transport''', was a massive [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] utilized by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Originally a corporate [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], the supply ship was adapted to compensate for the inadequate cargo capacities of other craft in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], particularly the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]. The supply ship was over one thousand [[Meter/Legends|meters]] wide and housed several [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays, which could accommodate multiple [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] to transport the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] to battlefields across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Being able to store over five million [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo, it was primarily used for arms and resupply shipments to the organic defense [[Army/Legends|armies]] in the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederacy military]], often supporting [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] campaigns from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. It was armed with [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|point-defense laser cannons]] and could be crewed by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] overseen by a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]].

During the lengthy [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] of [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Confederacy provided a [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship/Legends|Separatist supply ship]] to the [[Umbaran militia]], which used the transport to reopen supply lines to the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]] following the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] capture of an [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|Umbaran airbase]]. The supply ship sustained the [[Capital/Legends|capital's]] defenses until the craft was infiltrated and destroyed by a trio of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]&ndash;commandeered [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]], leading to the capital's fall to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. A number of supply ships were involved in the Confederacy's massive [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], the [[Dooku's palace/Legends|headquarters]] of [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], while [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used a pair of supply ships to support his [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|invasion]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Dooku also enlisted a pair of supply ships to supplement his [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|invasion]] of [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], a stronghold of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Uh, sir, we have confirmed that there are three commandeered starfighters heading toward the main reactor.''"<br />"''Strengthen our defenses.|A B1 battle droid and the T-series tactical droid commander of the supply ship at Umbara|<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />}}
[[File:SepSupplyShipBridge-PoD.png|thumb|left|250px|A Separatist supply ship and its droid crew could be overseen by a single tactical droid.]]
Initially a corporate [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] was converted as a model of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] craft by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It was 908.78 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and 910.35 meters tall, while its [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]] and barbell shape afforded a width of 1257.32 meters.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> It was armed with [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|point-defense laser cannons]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> but also relied upon other ships for protection.<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> Its body housed a number of [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays, which could carry multiple [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], each of which had a wingspan of 370 meters and a 150 meter height.<ref name="Encyclopedia: C-9979" /> The main hangar, accessible via an aft entry, was located in the midsection of the ship's starboard hemisphere and was equipped with ceiling cranes and other equipment for cargo loading and storage. At the end of the main hangar was the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] room, which was protected from outside access by [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielding]].<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />

The Separatist supply ship was painted with the [[Color/Legends|blue]] livery of the Confederacy, as well as with a [[Separatist hex icon/Legends|Confederate roundel]] on both sides of its hull.<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> It had an overall cargo capacity upward of five million [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]].<ref name="Cargo capacity" /> It was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Massacre" /> The transport could be commanded by a single [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], while [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] made up the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] team as well as the main hangar's cargo supply crew.<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />

==Role==
{{Quote|If we take out that supply ship, then we cut off arms to the capital.|Fives, to [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]|<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />}}
[[File:ConfederateNavyAtSerenno-Massacre.png|thumb|right|240px|Separatist supply ships serve in the Confederate Navy blockade of Serenno.]]
The Separatist supply ship served as a heavy transport in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> fulfilling the Confederacy's needs by compensating for the insufficient cargo capacity of other craft such as the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Federation battleship">{{SWE|technology|tradefederationbattleship|Trade Federation battleship}}</ref> Originally a corporate transport, the supply ship was converted for wartime service in the Confederate [[Navy/Legends|Navy]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> proving to be a more dedicated cargo [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] than other vessels.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Federation battleship" /> It became a valuable combat asset during lengthy conflicts due to its massive size and capacity, which allowed it to serve as a transport for C-9979 [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] and their [[Troop/Legends|troops]], the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: C-9979" /> Yet it primarily contributed to the Separatist war machine by supplying arms, power supplies, and other matériel&mdash;for example, long-range [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]&mdash;to organic defense [[Army/Legends|armies]] like the [[Umbaran militia]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Supply ships could be employed in campaigns from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], providing weaponry and supplies to ground forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] surface, while their isolated position in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] would allow them to be defended by [[Warship/Legends|warships]] of the Confederate Navy.<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />

==History==
{{Quote|Can't we destroy the supply ship?''"<br />"''We're trying, but with little success. Their fleet outnumbers ours and the extra ships we were promised have not yet arrived.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />}}
The supply ship initially served as a corporate vessel until being repurposed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, becoming an integral part of the supply chain of the Confederate Navy. As more member worlds contributed their organic-based armies to the Separatist war machine, supply ships were used to support them during campaigns against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], meeting a variety of replenishment needs, in addition to ferrying detachments of the Separatist [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] Army to the front lines. Due to its new role, it became known as the Separatist supply ship,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> or alternatively the Separatist support ship<ref name="Explore: Plan of Dissent">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/plan-of-dissent-episode-guide|text="Plan of Dissent" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> or Separatist transport.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Late in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,<ref name="FF-2014 7: Z-95" /> the Confederate world of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] was subjected to an [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invasion]] by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In response to the Republic [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Ground warfare/Legends|capture]] of an [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|airbase]] that had been supplying the defenses of the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]], the Confederate Navy provided the native [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] militia with a [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship/Legends|Separatist supply ship]], with a large [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of Confederate warships defending the transport. The vessel, commanded by a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Umbara)|T-series tactical droid]], remained in orbit and was used to rebuild the Umbarans' supply lines to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], providing the [[City/Legends|city's]] defenders with shipments of long-range missiles and other arms.<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />

[[File:SpaceBattleOfUmbara1-PoD.png|thumb|left|250px|The Confederate armada defends the supply ship over Umbara.]]
A fleet from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] targeted the Separatist supply ship to sever the capital's supply lines, but the [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] was unable to destroy the vessel due to being outclassed in strength by the Confederate armada. During the [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] over Umbara, [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and two 501st [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] and [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], undertook an unsanctioned mission to destroy the supply ship. They joined the space battle in stolen [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]], using them to slip past the supply ship's defenses,<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> as the battle droid crew was unable to identify that they were not friendlies until too late.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Once inside, Fives, Jesse, and Hardcase [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] through the main hangar, intending to blow up the ship by rupturing its reactor core. While the ship's droid crew attempted to defend their vessel from the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], the tactical droid [[Commander/Legends|commander]] activated the reactor chamber's ray [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], forcing the three [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to resort to other means. Hardcase manually walked one of his starfighter's missile pods through a service door into the reactor room, [[Death/Legends|sacrificing]] himself by driving the missile pod into the reactor. The resulting explosion consumed the supply ship and its crew and lit up the Umbaran skies; it could even be seen from the surface through the clouded [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The supply ship's destruction<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> enabled the Republic to conquer the capital and thus retake Umbara.<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

The Separatist stronghold of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], which housed the [[Dooku's palace/Legends|palatial headquarters]] of [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], was heavily [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by the Confederate Navy during the war.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Serenno">{{SWE|locations|serenno|Serenno}}</ref> Five Separatist supply ships were dedicated to the blockade, along with a considerable number of warships. When Dooku authorized an [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|assault]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to target his former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|agent]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] brought along a pair of supply ships to support his invasion. They remained in orbit of Dathomir with his invasion fleet, while he personally landed on the surface with a droid [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] aboard C-9979 landing craft to target the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], slaying the entire clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]].<ref name="Massacre" />

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the war's final year,<ref name="Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> Dooku brought along a pair of supply ships as part of an invasion fleet [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|targeting]] the planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], a stronghold of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Upon arrival at Scipio, Dooku had his forces obliterate the Republic's on-world clone trooper [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] and then proceeded to the surface, leaving the [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] [[Kraken/Legends|Kraken]] in command of the supply ships and the rest of the fleet. Just as [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived with a fleet of Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to retake the banks, Dooku returned to his armada in orbit and ordered a retreat from Scipio, and the supply ships joined in the withdrawal from the battlefield by jumping to hyperspace.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|George wanted to separate the Trade Federation vessels from the Separatists, period. Because something that's really come to light in ''The Clone Wars'' series is that George sees it as Separatists, Republic, and then in the middle is big business. The corporations. And he felt that the doughnut ships represented too much ''[of]'' the Trade Federation from ''Phantom Menace''.|Series Supervising Director Dave Filoni, on the decision to replace a ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship with the new Separatist supply ship in "Plan of Dissent"|<ref name="Umbara Commentary">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four]], "Darkened World of Umbara" Commentary</ref>}}
The Separatist supply ship was designed for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and debuted in the episode "[[Plan of Dissent]]," which aired as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] on [[November 11]], [[2011]]. Much of the design of the ship model's interior was constructed from existing assets made for previous episodes from the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], such as [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] from "[[Senate Murders]]," [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] pipe conduits in "[[The Zillo Beast]]," and spot [[Lamp/Legends|lamps]] from "[[The Zillo Beast Strikes Back]]."<ref name="Explore: Plan of Dissent" /> As part of its appearance in "Plan of Dissent," the supply ship received an [http://www.starwars.com/explore/encyclopedia/technology/separatistsupplyship entry] in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Supply ships have since been featured in the episodes "[[Massacre]]"<ref name="Massacre" /> and "[[Crisis at the Heart]]."<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />

In "Plan of Dissent," the supply ship aiding the Umbarans was originally a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] ''Lucrehulk''-class [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]]. According to Series Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]], Series Producer [[George Lucas]] asked that it be changed to a vessel more clearly affiliated with the Separatists, to show that the Trade Federation was more of a neutral corporation in the Clone Wars. The result was the Separatist supply ship, with its [[in-universe]] connection with the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship being that the larger supply ship was more suited for the task.<ref name="Umbara Commentary" />
